name: @pipeworx/mcp-china-commerce

tools.name: mofcom_odi
tools.description: China's non-financial outward direct investment (对外直接投资, ODI) — monthly YEAR-TO-DATE CUMULATIVE amount in USD 100M, number of enterprises investing abroad, and the count of countries/regions reached, each with year-over-year %. Sourced live from MOFCOM's (商务部) data centre, keyless. Values reset down every January (累计 = Jan-through-month, not a standalone monthly flow) — the response's `note` field restates this. No per-country breakdown is available (the country count is a COUNT, not a split by destination). Answers "China's outward FDI this year", "how many Chinese enterprises are investing abroad", "China ODI growth rate".

start_period.description: Earliest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM (e.g. "2024-01" or "202401"). Omit for full history.

end_period.description: Latest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM. Omit for the most recent available month.

limit.description: Max rows to return, newest first (default 24, max 500). Ignored range still comes from start_period/end_period — this only caps how many of those rows come back.

tools.name: mofcom_overseas_contracting
tools.description: China's overseas contracted engineering projects (对外承包工程) — monthly YEAR-TO-DATE CUMULATIVE value of newly signed contracts and completed turnover, both in USD 100M, each with year-over-year %. Sourced live from MOFCOM's (商务部) data centre, keyless. Values reset down every January. Answers "value of China's overseas construction/engineering contracts", "Chinese contractors' overseas project turnover".

start_period.description: Earliest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM (e.g. "2024-01" or "202401"). Omit for full history.

end_period.description: Latest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM. Omit for the most recent available month.

limit.description: Max rows to return, newest first (default 24, max 500). Ignored range still comes from start_period/end_period — this only caps how many of those rows come back.

tools.name: mofcom_labor_cooperation
tools.description: China's overseas labour dispatch (对外劳务合作) — monthly YEAR-TO-DATE CUMULATIVE count (in 10,000-person units) of Chinese workers dispatched abroad, split by whether they went out under contracted-engineering projects or under standalone labour-cooperation contracts, plus the year-over-year change (an ABSOLUTE change in 10,000-person units, not a percent). Sourced live from MOFCOM's (商务部) data centre, keyless. Values reset down every January. Answers "how many Chinese workers are sent abroad", "China overseas labour export trend".

start_period.description: Earliest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM (e.g. "2024-01" or "202401"). Omit for full history.

end_period.description: Latest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM. Omit for the most recent available month.

limit.description: Max rows to return, newest first (default 24, max 500). Ignored range still comes from start_period/end_period — this only caps how many of those rows come back.

tools.name: mofcom_fdi_utilised
tools.description: Utilised inbound foreign direct investment into China (吸收外商直接投资) and newly established FDI enterprises — monthly YEAR-TO-DATE CUMULATIVE figures, each with year-over-year %. Sourced live from MOFCOM's (商务部) data centre, keyless. Values reset down every January. The monetary amount (USD 100M) stopped being published through this feed around mid-2023 — recent rows carry the enterprise COUNT only, with the dollar figure null. Answers "how much FDI is China attracting", "new foreign-invested enterprises in China this year".

start_period.description: Earliest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM (e.g. "2024-01" or "202401"). Omit for full history.

end_period.description: Latest period to include, as YYYYMM or YYYY-MM. Omit for the most recent available month.

limit.description: Max rows to return, newest first (default 24, max 500). Ignored range still comes from start_period/end_period — this only caps how many of those rows come back.

tools.name: mofcom_series_list
tools.description: Lists the four MOFCOM data-centre series this pack covers (ODI, overseas contracting, labour cooperation, utilised FDI) with their Chinese/English names, units, and the live earliest/latest period each currently has — a cheap discovery call before picking which of the other four tools to use.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-china-commerce forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the china-commerce pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
